set -euo pipefail
run_security=1
dry_run=0
run_security_scan() {
    local matches
    local status
    local secret_patterns
    local grep_args
    if [ "$run_security" -eq 0 ]; then
        mark_step_skipped "Skipping security scan."
        return 0
    fi

    secret_patterns='AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{36,255}|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{20,}|sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|-----BEGIN ((RSA|DSA|EC|OPENSSH|PGP) )?PRIVATE KEY-----'
    grep_args=(
        git grep -nI -E "$secret_patterns" --
        .
        ':(exclude)blorp/build/_build'
        ':(exclude)_build'
        ':(exclude).git'
    )

    # Absolute paths into a user's home or per-user temp directory name the
    # machine's user and its layout. Records and scripts spell them as
    # <repo>, <worktree:NAME>, $TMPDIR or ~ instead. The scan covers tracked
    # files and is deliberately narrow: shared temp paths such as /tmp name
    # no user.
    local local_path_patterns='/User[s]/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/|/hom[e]/[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*/|/var/folder[s]/'
    local path_grep_args=(
        git grep -nI -E "$local_path_patterns" --
        .
        ':(exclude)blorp/build/_build'
        ':(exclude)_build'
        ':(exclude).git'
    )

    if [ "$dry_run" -eq 1 ]; then
        run_cmd "${grep_args[@]}"
        run_cmd "${path_grep_args[@]}"
        return 0
    fi

    set +e
    matches=$("${grep_args[@]}" 2>&1)
    status=$?
    set -e

    if [ "$status" -gt 1 ]; then
        echo "Security scan failed:" >&2
        echo "$matches" >&2
        return "$status"
    fi

    if [ "$status" -eq 1 ]; then
        matches=""
    fi

    if [ -n "$matches" ]; then
        echo "Potential secret material found:" >&2
        echo "$matches" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    echo "No high-confidence secret patterns found."

    set +e
    matches=$("${path_grep_args[@]}" 2>&1)
    status=$?
    set -e

    if [ "$status" -gt 1 ]; then
        echo "Local path scan failed:" >&2
        echo "$matches" >&2
        return "$status"
    fi

    if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "Machine-local paths found in tracked files; write <repo>, <worktree:NAME>, \$TMPDIR or ~ instead:" >&2
        # A match in a single-line JSON record can be very long.
        echo "$matches" | cut -c1-200 >&2
        return 1
    fi

    echo "No machine-local paths found."
}

run_security_scan
